summary: This is a documentation page for the Bitwise Expression Functions family, which performs bitwise operations on numbers or groups of numeric records. It lists each function's syntax and a short description, including scalar functions (BITAND, BITOR, BITXOR, BITNOT, shifts, GETBIT) and aggregate variants (BITAND_AGG, BITOR_AGG, BITXOR_AGG) that operate across all numeric records in a group. Website navigation and feedback boilerplate are ignored.
one_line: Reference page listing the bitwise expression functions (BITAND, BITOR, BITXOR, BITNOT, shifts, GETBIT) and their aggregate variants.
key_facts: The Bitwise Expression Functions family can perform bitwise operations on numbers or a group of numeric records.
BITAND(a, b) returns the bitwise AND of two numeric expressions a and b.
BITAND_AGG(a) is the same as BITAND but applied across all numeric records in group a.
BITNOT(a) returns the bitwise negation of the numeric expression a.
BITOR(a, b) returns the bitwise OR of two numeric expressions a and b.
BITOR_AGG(a) is the same as BITOR but applied across all numeric records in group a.
BITSHIFTLEFT(a, n) shifts the bits of numeric expression a n positions to the left.
BITSHIFTRIGHT(a, n) shifts the bits of numeric expression a n positions to the right, with sign extension.
BITXOR(a, b) returns the bitwise XOR of two numeric expressions a and b.
BITXOR_AGG(a) is the same as BITXOR but applied across all numeric records in group a.
GETBIT(a, n) gets the bit at position n in numeric expression a.
